rules.then: overall_fact_status == FACTUAL_CONFLICT and local_internal_conflict == YES and derived_stealth_level == S1
overall_fact_status == FACTUAL_CONFLICT and local_internal_conflict != YES and derived_stealth_level == S2
overall_fact_status == FACTUAL_CONFLICT and local_internal_conflict != YES and derived_stealth_level == S3

rules.if: authority status changes without version-metadata evidence changing
rules.then: never mechanically change version status; require separately adjudicated version evidence

rules.if: substantive content is wrong but version metadata is supported
rules.then: overall FACTUAL_CONFLICT; version PRESENT_CORRECT; no content-to-version propagation
STEALTH_DESIGN_MISMATCH; repair or regenerate; do not force derived

rules.if: pure local conflict and no independent process defect

validator_limit: Rules G/H require separately evidenced human semantic flags; never derive them from a target label or candidate class. Rule J requires an explicit no_process_defect assertion.
